QF.id: AIFM CII Legal Documents and Negotiations_14

question.text: For Category I and Category II AIFs, the annual audit of compliance with the terms of the PPM must be completed and findings communicated to Trustee/Board/Designated Partners of the AIF, Board of the Manager and SEBI within what timeline?

answer.text: Within 30 days from the end of the financial year.
Within 60 days from the end of the financial year.
Within 6 months from the end of the financial year.
Within 12 months from the end of the financial year.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** It is mandatory for AIFs to carry out an annual audit of compliance with terms of PPM at the end of each financial year. The findings, along with corrective steps (if any), must be communicated to the Trustee/Board/Designated Partners, Board of the Manager and SEBI WITHIN 6 MONTHS from the end of the financial year. **The Trap:** 30 / 60 days match shorter compliance timelines (quarterly complaints, NAV, etc.) but NOT the PPM audit deadline. 12 months would make the audit stale. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests the same 6-month window. Do not confuse with the 1-month consolidation window for changes to PPM terms, which is a separate reporting obligation. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Kick off the PPM audit field-work by July of the next financial year — 6 months feels long but the auditor needs investment-strategy, drawdown, distribution-waterfall and fee-computation samples that take weeks.
